conditions_by_beat_id.70: Aegon accepts and follows a consequential plan proposed by Tyland after Tyland explains the plan to him.
conditions_by_beat_id.75: Larys gives Aegon specific intelligence about an immediate threat and Aegon acts on the warning.
conditions_by_beat_id.85: Daeron reluctantly carries out a clearly stated order from Ormund that he initially resists or dislikes.
conditions_by_beat_id.90: Ulf follows a consequential order from Ormund that directly harms or obstructs the Blacks.
conditions_by_beat_id.92: Daeron carries out a consequential political or military action after Ormund explicitly pressures or orders him to do it.
conditions_by_beat_id.104: Jon carries out a consequential direct order from Ormund in the finale.
conditions_by_beat_id.113: Addam follows a consequential direct order from Rhaenyra even though it conflicts with Alyn, Corlys, or Baela's wishes.
conditions_by_beat_id.118: Alyn gives a military or naval order that is visibly obeyed by Velaryon soldiers, sailors, or ships.
conditions_by_beat_id.126: Hugh follows a consequential Black military order despite Kat objecting or being endangered by the choice.
conditions_by_beat_id.142: Oscar gives Roddy a direct battlefield instruction and Roddy visibly follows it.
conditions_by_beat_id.146: Oscar gives a battlefield order that is visibly obeyed by a substantial group of Riverland or allied soldiers.

exclusions: Giving, hearing, acknowledging, discussing, or agreeing with an order, plan, pressure, warning, or objection does not count unless the preserved consequential response or obedience also occurs.
Coincidental action, pre-existing intent, independent action, or a proxy acting without the preserved command relationship does not count.
An off-screen report, recap, mention, dream, vision, memory, prediction, promotional image, or hypothetical version of the order or outcome does not count.
families.title_review_note: Each title honestly names a consequential command, plan, warning, pressure, or battlefield-order outcome; settlement requires the preserved instruction relationship and its required completed response.
